name: 开机动画 + 聊天壁纸
author: LeeRolling
description: 给 DSH 加开机动画与聊天壁纸：分幕模板引擎（1–24 幕）、自带配色/文案/配音、网页版编辑器、模板商店。首帧注入不露 Loading 卡片，桌面标题栏在片头期间透明化。
descriptionEn: Boot animation plus chat wallpaper for DSH: a stepped template engine (1–24 acts), per-template colours, copy and voice, a browser editor with live preview, and a one-click template store. The first frame is injected before DSH's loading card can paint.
